title: Terminal Defects, Growing Multiplicity, and Variance Extremality in the Double Dixie Cup Problem
summary: We develop a terminal-defect method for the double Dixie cup problem and use it to prove the finite-variance extremality conjecture of Doumas and Papanicolaou. For every \(m\ge1\) and \(N\ge2\), among all positive coupon probability vectors \(p=(p_1,\ldots,p_N)\), the variance of the time \(T_m(N)\) to collect \(m\) complete sets is uniquely minimized at the uniform vector. We prove the stronger radial statement that the variance is strictly increasing along every ray from the uniform vector.
